description: This PHP script manages various aspects of the home dashboard module in the vtiger CRM, including fetching user-specific filters, managing dashboard widgets, handling layout configurations, sequencing dashboard blocks, and processing user actions related to the home page customization.

classes.name: Users
classes.description: A class representing user-related operations, including fetching the order of dashboard widgets.

methods.name: getHomeStuffOrder
